name: Riding mower or lawn tractor

comps.spec: Single or V-twin petrol engine, 15–25 hp, electric start, vertical shaft
comps.loc: Under the hood or behind the seat

comps.spec: Hydrostatic drive pumps and wheel motors (hydrostatic tractors and zero-turns)
comps.loc: Rear axle or each drive wheel

comps.spec: Drive and deck belts, pulleys and idlers
Petrol left in the tank, 5–12 L (stale after some months)
comps.loc: Tank under the seat or hood

comps.spec: Seat, brake and blade safety switches
12V headlights: a 27W bulb on the Deere E100 and a bulb holder on the Husqvarna YTH18542 (bulb type not stated); Toro sells an LED kit as an accessory
Blade fuse in the wiring harness: 20A on the Husqvarna YTH18542, 15A and 25A on the Toro 75748
comps.loc: Behind the dash, with the wiring harness

comps.spec: Fuel tank, about 9–11.4 L (2.4–3 gal) on the models checked
Steel mower blades on the deck (two on the Toro 75748; the count varies by deck) — razor sharp, so pull the spark plug lead first
Electric blade clutch with its engine pulley on some mowers (Toro 75748, part 117-7468), worked from the battery by the blade-control (PTO) switch

notes: The whole tractor is a slow load hauler with a trailer. The engine runs a generator head well on a belt.
